name: watchlist_manage
description: CRUD operations for watchlists. A watchlist is a named collection of entities you want to track over time. Supported entity types: IP addresses, stock tickers, geographic regions, CVE IDs, vessel names/MMSIs, and aircraft callsigns. Watchlists persist to disk and survive server restarts.

parameters.action: string (required) — One of: create, list, get, add_items, remove_items, delete
parameters.name: string (optional) — Watchlist name. Required for all actions except list.
parameters.type: string (optional) — Entity type: ip, ticker, region, cve, vessel, callsign. Required for create.
parameters.items: array of strings (optional) — Items to add or remove. Required for add_items and remove_items.

examples.description: Create a watchlist for suspicious IPs
